response.overview: Only a few weeks after the United States invaded Iraq in 2003, former President George W. Bush gave a televised speech on the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln declaring that his country had prevailed. Primetime Mr. President analyzes the speech, dubbed as “Mission Accomplished,” through the lens of what Iraqis had endured and would endure as a result of the war and its aftermath, from horrible insurgency, civil and sectarian wars, political corruption, and the overarching sense of death and despair.
response.title: Primetime Mr. President
